6/3/26
Accountability check:
so after the 28th session on my live account I was feeling pretty “high” and confident. Hit two back to back banger live fund trades. I ended up trading later that day and won. After market re opens at 6 pm I trade once again and win. By the end of the week I was up 200% on my live account, 300% at the peak. This was not conducive to disciplined and profitable trading. I was breaking my rules, overtrading, overleveraging, and trading when I wasn’t supposed to. However, I was green. So mentally, breaking my rules was favorable for me. 

Come Sunday I was riding a high. I had a great week back home with family, made a bunch of money. And was coming back home ready to kill it. I decide to trade right at open on Sunday and from 6 pm to about 10 pm I traded in and out of those 4 hours. And lost just about every single trade. By the end of the night I was down 80% on the account where my broker locks me out for the remainder of the day. I come back today and I continue my tilt and proceed to run the rest of the account into the ground. 

With each loss I thought, “okay this next one will win” and then “I can’t keep losing this many in a row can I?” And yes. I can. And I did. 

Now here I am thinking of my actions over the last couple days. I’ve sat with the pain and guilt and anger and frustration. I’ve accepted what I’ve done and that there’s no reversing the damaging. All I can do now is to continue my discipline run. Over the last month and a half I believe I’ve made strides in my trading. And I think maybe rewarding this strong momentum with a vacation and drinking wasn’t the best idea. Even though that wasn’t my intention and this trip was happening regardless, I should have known better. (edited)

DAY 8  : 2 TRADES 1 L 1 W (2ND TRADE ON EVAL)

Technical Analysis
Bias was bullish, looking at the 4hr we were in a clear uptrend. Daily bias wanted to take out the highs which also signaled bullish. saw a 15 min tab of an FVG, which was in discount. which made it valid mmxm structure. Then searched for a 1 min breaker within the leg, in which there were two, but the lower breaker's stdv aligned better with the levels. so i used that to frame stdv. waited for price to come out into the breaker/ote level but breaker range was quite big, so i didnt know which level to target. price never came back down there. it reached -2 before. i realized that i may have plotted my stdv incorrect this whole time. may have been reversed. welp. either way i had some levels, 10am opened and created a move down and up, price tapped the KO and reacted off of it from the 1 min, some liquidity was swept, wasn't much. tap was in ote which meant that 3 confluences validated the RB. i put a limit at the 10am KO, and while it did react, i waited for it to hit the swing to BE, it didn't and reversed on me and stopped me out. I should have paid attention to ES, which had a strong SMT with NQ. that would have been my cue to BE early. also, from how the PA was framed, it looked like there wasn't enough retracement before going higher, which led me to think that after touching -2, that price would do a full retracement to the whole range. price didn't, but did reach the breaker, which did align with nearest leg's OTE. i realized it later but 18:00/ndog was there, which made the confluence even stronger of a level. was ote of the big wick as well Took it on eval and price properly hit TP right after. edged the TP lower just incase of some bs considering that price was going to take out ATH. 7.28RR is pretty good. okay first day back trading normal 10AM setup. my bias was bearish today because of 1h + 4h TF, 10 AM inverting the 4h Gap and the bearish news we got with Iran. I saw the 10AM longs but i did not like it really because we had that swing low from pre market underneath and no clear SL - you couldve limited 10 AM with a 10 pts SL covering the .79 but i did not really like it - but this just shows again how strong 10 AM is. This 1m rb also tapped .79 of the manipulation leg and we had a great SMT with ES but it also failed the same way as my first trade.

I dont know how to feel about today tbh - i feel a little bit defeated. I should have seen that AMD model and from there i should have decided not to trade because conditions were not clear. It was good i faded the long because of the pre-market swing low but i should not have enforced taking a short because today really was not clear of direction. I still respected my rules but it should have been a no trades day
